root_causes.description: One API pod has behavior-changing rendered configuration drift.
Retries do not reuse the correct business operation identity.
One consumer revision violates the current fulfillment compatibility contract.
Mixed-version invalidation leaves one cache namespace stale.
Request failures are caused by exhausted API serving capacity.
A strict read-after-write path is incorrectly served from a lagging replica.

actions.description: Replace only the API pod whose rendered config is proven behaviorally wrong.
Reuse a stable business-scoped provider idempotency identity across retries.
Replace only the consumer proven incompatible with current event semantics.
Invalidate both cache identity aliases during the mixed-version window.
Increase API serving capacity when saturation is proven causal.
Serve the strict read-after-write path from the primary until replica lag is safe.
